Same single-s/double-s spelling variant as Julia Bourasa Riley (database has 'NELLIE BOURASSA'). BLM: fee patent accession 715734, allotment 804, 80 acres, OK/Pottawatomie county, signed 1919-10-30, Indian Fee Patent. Converted from her 1892 original Indian Allotment trust patent accession 0508-352 (80 acres). She is NOT in the 1983 Federal Register forced-fee claims (no forced_fee_patents_rails record), unlike her sister/relative Julia Bourasa Riley — meaning her 1919 patent was either voluntarily applied for or otherwise excluded from the 1983 forced-fee population, even though her name did appear on the Shawnee Indian Agency's 1928 Circular 2464 master list.
